node.label: Cerebellar ataxia associated with quadrupedal gait
node.definition: The presence of cerebellar signs and symptoms such as lack of balance associated with quadrupedal gait (locomotion on all four extremities with a 'bear-like' gait with the legs held straight).

evidence.snippet: Spinocerebellar ataxia 29, congenital nonprogressive: Cerebellar ataxia associated with quadrupedal gait (frequency 7/7) [PCS]
Medulloblastoma: Cerebellar ataxia associated with quadrupedal gait (frequency HP:0040282) [TAS]
